mainEntity.name: How can I maximize storage in a small mudroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maximizing storage in a small mudroom requires thoughtful design that utilizes vertical space and incorporates multi-functional elements. Consider tall, narrow lockers, wall-mounted shelving, and benches with integrated drawers or lift-top storage. Using hooks for coats and bags can free up floor space.
